hook: chaff 是打趣玩笑，chagrin 是懊惱，cherubic 是天使臉——更衣室三面鏡子：玩笑、懊惱、無辜。
script: chaff＝打趣。chagrin＝懊惱失望。cherubic＝天使般天真。教練：開玩笑別笑得失控，懊惱別寫成天使臉，三個詞共用 ch- 開頭但情緒完全不同。

members.senseAnchor: material consisting of seed coverings and small pieces of stem or leaves that have been separated from the seeds; foil in thin strips; ejected into the air as a radar countermeasure
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 玩笑鏡: chaff walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「玩笑鏡」出場：chaff 一上場梗就黏住——打趣。

related.synonyms: husk, shuck, stalk, straw, stubble, kid

members.speakLineZh: 請「懊惱鏡」出場：chagrin 一上場梗就黏住——懊惱。

members.senseAnchor: having a sweet nature befitting an angel or cherub

members.speakLineZh: 請「無辜鏡」出場：cherubic 一上場梗就黏住——天使般的。
